newsitem.title: UK: Lilleshall sees loss for year.
newsitem.headline: Lilleshall sees loss for year.

text.p: British plastic products firm Lilleshall Plc said on Monday it expected to report a loss for the current year, including a provision related to the sale of its Vanplas unit to Laird Group Plc.
Lilleshall said it would take a net goodwill write-off of 636,000 stg related to the sale that would be treated as an exceptional item in its 1996 accounts.
The company said Laird's Feneseal Ltd paid 3.15 million stg for Vanplas, a distributor which had an operating profit of 288,000 stg last year.
"However, trading in the current year has been disappointing which, including a provision for loss on sale, will result in a loss for the year," the company said in its statement.
The firm's shares were marked down 2.0p to 65.5 by 0820 GMT.
Lilleshall said the sale completed its withdrawal from the building materials supply market.
